LESSON: WORK TALENTS, GIFTS AND ABILITIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.5: Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Work Talents, Gifts and Abilities
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you discover your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify their God-given talents, gifts and abilities
2. describe the parable of the talents in Matthew 25:14-30
3. discuss lessons learnt from the parable of the talents
4. apply lessons learnt from the parable of talents in daily life
